notes: Premium: sinking funds. Set money aside each month for the costs you know are coming — car repairs, insurance, the holidays — so the next one doesn’t land on a credit card.

Each fund can count toward your plan or just be tracked. A fund that counts is money not going to your debts, so your payoff dates account for it honestly rather than assuming that money was available.
Funds with a target stop once they’re full, and that money goes back to your debts from then on — your dates reflect that too.
